notes.title: Camplandia Facelift
notes.notes:
[p]Hey campers! ⛺

I've been hard at work polishing up Camplandia, and today I'm excited to share a new(ish) trailer that better captures the spirit of the game.

You can watch the new trailer on the official Steam page or here:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/qMNv3SnUQYA"][/dynamiclink]
Along with the trailer, I’ve also updated the store page assets and screenshots to better reflect the feel of the game.

Thanks for following along and supporting Camplandia! I look forward to releasing more updates in the new year.

– OddBall Game Dev[/p]
